task.title: Parameter sweep for baseline optimiser
task.objective: Run a small parameter sweep for the planner-provided baseline optimiser and report the best observed configuration.
task.scope: Use only the provided baseline code and dataset. Generate numerical metrics, a summary table, and diagnostic figures.
non_goals: Do not search for alternative algorithms.
Do not rewrite the global research plan.
Do not generate final coursework code or a PDF report.

inputs.description: Planner-approved dataset for this execution request.

success_criteria.description: Produce results.json containing baseline metrics, attempted configurations, and the best observed configuration.
At least one attempted configuration must improve the baseline objective metric.
Produce at least one diagnostic plot under figures/.

budget.max_compute_notes: Keep the sweep small enough for local execution.
